__inputs.name: DS_POSTGRES
__inputs.label: Postgres
__inputs.description: The cairn-api Postgres database (read replica recommended). Queries the subscription table — CLAUDE.md §2.14 / §20: it is the single canonical source of subscription state.

title: Cairn Billing State Distribution
description: Snapshot of subscription lifecycle status and entitlement distribution from the canonical `subscription` table (apps/server/src/db/schema.ts). Read-only reporting queries; never used as a hot-path entitlement check (that's EntitlementService).

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, count(*) AS value FROM subscription GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT entitlement, count(*) AS value FROM subscription GROUP BY entitlement ORDER BY entitlement

panels.title: In grace period (past_due, within grace window)
panels.description: A past_due subscription still grants its entitlement until grace_until lapses (CLAUDE.md §20). Watch this for dunning health.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM subscription WHERE status = 'past_due' AND grace_until > now()

panels.title: Past grace (should be canceled)
panels.description: past_due rows whose grace window has lapsed. Should trend to zero — the dunning job downgrades these to canceled.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM subscription WHERE status = 'past_due' AND grace_until <= now()
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM subscription WHERE status = 'trial' AND trial_ends_at BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '7 days'
SELECT coalesce(provider, 'none') AS provider, count(*) AS subscriptions FROM subscription GROUP BY provider ORDER BY subscriptions DESC
